We got chicken, finally!
Mar 2025 • Friends
Best non-Vietnamese food we had in Da Nang! It was our last night in this city, and we wanted chicken for dinner. It has been a challenge to find good chicken dishes among the hundreds of seafood restaurants in town! Thankgoodness, Nomad Kitchen’s menu offers many mouthwatering chicken option! We ordered roasted chicken breast (served with roasted potatoes, broccoli, carrot); chicken pesto sandwich (on focaccia bread with pesto sauce, sun dried tomatoes, cheese); general Tso’s chicken (special of the day, with crispy chicken in sweet sesame sauce, served with steamed rice, broccoli, green beans). Everything was incredible, chicken breast in each dish was perfectly prepared, so tender, so flavorful, so tasty. Our sweet, friendly waitress Trinh suggested chocolate brownie topped with pistachio gelato for dessert. Delicious, a must try! One friend was able to order Vietnamese decaf cappuccino, which was also hard to find since everybody drinks strong, fully caffeinated coffee in Vietnam. Such a great restaurant, incredible food, lovely ambience, and excellent service. Very highly recommend.
